title: Single fixed-parameter coefficient rescaling and kernel stabilization
statement: Let k:Type u be a field of characteristic p>0, Lambda:Type v a Noetherian commutative k-algebra, q a prime, L=Lambda_q, m its maximal ideal, N>0, n at least N, c>0, and S=L/m^n [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Let u_j (j in Fin d) be elements of q whose images form a regular sequence in L [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Let z_j (j in Fin s) be elements of Lambda with m^N contained in their extended ideal. Let D:Type w be a commutative local Artinian k-algebra, S local, and g:D to S a flat local homomorphism commuting with k [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Suppose b_j in D map to the residues of z_j, and all residues of u_j lie in g(D). Fix i in Fin d and t:Fin d to Lambda with t_j outside q whenever j<i. There exist l outside q, ell_j in Lambda, and a commutative local Artinian k-algebra D':Type(max u v w), a k-algebra map h:D to D', and a flat local map g':D' to S, with g'h=g, such that D' is essentially smooth over D via h [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map], (u_i l)^(2N)=sum_j ell_j z_j in Lambda, and multiplication by u_i l and its square have equal kernels on Lambda modulo the span of (u_j t_j)^(8c) for j<i. The residues of l and all ell_j belong to g'(D').

source.place: Lemma 07FJ, lemma-resolve-general, item-choose-deltai, ad (13): one successor step

proof.text: Apply the localized coefficient relation to u_i, using only its residue membership and the coefficient lifts b. Obtain w_j with an exact relation in L and residues in g(D).

Write w_j=v_j/s0 with a common denominator s0 outside q. Choose s1 outside q killing the cleared equation error. For s=s0*s1 set mu_j=s^(2N-1)*s1*v_j. The equality (s*u_i)^(2N)=sum mu_j*z_j holds in Lambda, and mu_j/s^(2N)=w_j in L. Use the generic Artinian enlargement to capture the residue of s^r for r>0. Replace s by s^r and mu_j by s^(2N(r-1))*mu_j. Residue membership follows by multiplication, and the equation persists.

The preceding t_j and s are units after localization. Unit multiplication preserves the regular sequence, and positive powers of preceding parameters preserve regularity. Thus the current s*u_i has equal first and square kernels in the localized preceding-power quotient. Ogoma gives s' outside q whose every positive power stabilizes the kernels in the Lambda quotient. Capture a positive power of s' by the generic Artinian enlargement, multiply s by it and each mu_j by its 2N-th power. This gives l and ell_j with the kernel equality and both residue memberships. Compose the two extensions; give D' the k-structure through D, making h a k-algebra map.

The target S is local Artinian: n>0 and Lambda is Noetherian. The enlargement constructions use finite polynomial rings, quotients and localizations over D, so all carriers can be taken in max u v w. No earlier coefficient rows are modified. Empty coefficient families are valid because the same error argument applies to the zero ideal.

proof_origin.note: Compiled Lean assembly: common denominators, two Artinian enlargements, powered regularity, Ogoma and composition. The localized coefficient relation is separately proved from Mathlib.

theorem exists_popescu_coefficient_step
    {k : Type u} {Λ : Type v} [Field k] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ) (N n : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hn : N ≤ n)
    (d s c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (uΛ : Fin d → Λ) (hu : ∀ j, uΛ j ∈ q.asIdeal)
    (hsequence : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
      (List.ofFn (fun j ↦ algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (uΛ j))))
    (z : Fin s → Λ)
    (hpower : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ N ≤
      (Ideal.span (Set.range z)).map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))
    (D : Type w) [CommRing D] [IsLocalRing D] [IsArtinianRing D] [Algebra k D]
    (g : D →+* Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⧸
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n)
    [IsLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⧸
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n)]
    [IsLocalHom g] (hgflat : g.Flat)
    (hgk : ∀ x : k, g (algebraMap k D x) = algebraMap k _ x)
    (b : Fin s → D)
    (hb : ∀ j, g (b j) = Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n)
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (z j)))
    (hinc : ∀ j, Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n)
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (uΛ j)) ∈ Set.range g)
    (i : Fin d) (t : Fin d → Λ) (ht : ∀ j, j.val < i.val → t j ∉ q.asIdeal) :
    ∃ (l : Λ) (ell : Fin s → Λ),
      l ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
      (uΛ i * l) ^ (2 * N) = ∑ j : Fin s, ell j * z j ∧
      (∀ x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {y | ∃ j : Fin d, j.val < i.val ∧
        y = (uΛ j * t j) ^ (c * 8)},
        (uΛ i * l) • x = 0 ↔ (uΛ i * l) ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
      ∃ (D' : Type (max u v w)) (_ : CommRing D') (_ : IsLocalRing D')
        (_ : IsArtinianRing D') (_ : Algebra k D')
        (h : D →ₐ[k] D')
        (g' : D' →+* Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⧸
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n),
        IsLocalHom g' ∧ g'.Flat ∧
        (letI : Algebra D D' := h.toRingHom.toAlgebra; EssentiallySmooth D D') ∧
        g'.comp h.toRingHom = g ∧
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n)
          (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) l) ∈ Set.range g' ∧
        (∀ j, Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n)
          (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (ell j)) ∈ Set.range g')
